messages:
maria (Platform): Quick design sync — proposing two new request headers to give SDKs and advanced customers routing control: X-Redwood-Region-Hint and X-Redwood-Tier-Override. Want to align on semantics, fallback, telemetry keys, and Console UX.

akshay (SDK): Nice. Are these hints or hard overrides? also how do they interact with quotas?

maria (Platform): The idea: default is 'hint' behavior. server will try to honor when capacity exists. Add an explicit mode for 'enforce' via header or flag if customer has dedicated capacity + entitlements. Quota accounting remains by customer id; tier override does NOT change quota buckets unless tenant-level mapping exists.

lee (Runtime): Two quick runtime concerns: 1) If too many requests flood a region due to hints we end up moving load and tripping cross-region throttles. We should expose both 'prefer' and 'require' semantics (eg hint vs enforce). 2) telemetry: need event that says "routed_by_hint" vs "forced_by_override" so we can attribute.

maria (Platform): Agreed. Proposal: X-Redwood-Region-Hint: value=region-code (e.g. eu-west-1). X-Redwood-Tier-Override: value=free|standard|premium. And X-Redwood-Routing-Mode: prefer|require. If require + no capacity, respond 409 w/ structured fallback info or a canonical fallback token.

akshay (SDK): Example usage from client perspective:
```
// JS SDK pseudo
client = new RedwoodClient({
  regionHint: 'eu-west-1',
  tier: 'premium',
  routingMode: 'prefer',
  debugRouting: true, // sends X-Redwood-Debug-Routing: trace=true
})
```
Also we should surface a nice error when require fails so apps can fallback gracefully.

tara (Product): For Console rollout controls we need: 1) toggle to simulate headers for a route (simulate region/tier), 2) per-route telemetry view showing percent of requests honoring hint vs falling back, 3) UX for admins to set tenant-level policy mapping (e.g. customer X always maps premium->dedicated).

lee (Runtime): Fallback hierarchy I propose: 1) same variant family in target region (if available), 2) same tier different region, 3) next lower tier in same region, 4) global default fallback. We should include a 'fallback_path' array in responses when not honoring hint. Example response header: X-Redwood-Fallback-Path: base->eu-west-1:unavailable->us-west-2:premium-fallback

akshay (SDK): For debug and QA we should support X-Redwood-Debug-Routing: trace=true to force route decisions to return detailed routing metadata in payload (not in prod unless allowed). Also allow sdk call option to record simulated decisions without sending header (Console simulate option).

maria (Platform): Telemetry event keys: routing.request_hint, routing.request_enforce, routing.fallback_taken (with reason tag), routing.honored. We'll add counters and p50/p95 for latency per 'honor' result. Also need an alert when honor_rate drops below threshold for any region-tier pair.

tara (Product): UX note: when a tenant toggles 'require' in Console we need an explicit safety modal explaining possible 409s and a test button to run a dry-run across a sample workload. Add inline docs link.

deploy-bot: canary deployed routing-rule-service v2.3 to staging at 2103212500 :rocket:

lee (Runtime): One more: enforce mode should only be allowed for tenants with Dedicated entitlements; otherwise system should strip header and log suspicious header usage (audit event).

maria (Platform): Action items:
- akshay: SDK flags + debug header support (PR for JS/py) — owner akshay — due EOD Thu
- lee: implement telemetry event names + fallback_path header — owner lee — due next Tue
- tara: console simulate toggle mockups + safety modal copy — owner tara — due Mon
- infra: add alert rule for honor_rate by region-tier — I'll create ticket

akshay (SDK): ack, will open PR and include opt-in beta flag for customers.

tara (Product): :thumbsup: adding docs page to the rollout docs.

maria (Platform): Thanks all — I'll draft formal spec and share link here when ready.
